global_prompt: A photorealistic cinematic family scene set in a cozy suburban home on a sunny morning, captured in one continuous handheld tracking shot without cuts. Natural character interactions, realistic animal movements, fluid camera tracking, warm morning sunlight, and consistent spatial continuity throughout.
local_prompts: The camera follows a golden retriever weaving between the legs of family members gathered around a busy breakfast table.
The dog stands on its hind legs, placing its front paws against the edge of the table.
A young schoolboy gently pats the dog's head and feeds it a strip of bacon.
The boy gets up from the breakfast table, and the camera follows him as he picks up his school backpack.
The camera tracks the boy as he runs out the front door toward a waiting yellow school bus and climbs aboard.
The camera turns around to reveal the golden retriever standing sadly in the front doorway, watching the school bus drive away.
